content.body:
The fast and low-profiled A15 (Crusader II) was an evolution of the A13 with slightly better armor. Unfortunately, it still bore the 2 pdr cannon, which was quickly becoming obsolescent against up-armored the Panzer III H and the Panzer IV G.
The initial productions of the Crusader II also included another crewman serving a bow-mounted machinegun in sub-turret at the left front, but this was found to be cramped, poorly ventilated, and nearly impossible to escape in an emergency so it was generally removed.
Functionally almost identical to the A13, the A15 is a good tank with a gun capable of killing most medium tanks. The green color and QF 2 pdr gun make it excellent from ambush, although the characteristically weak British optics somewhat negate the range advantage of the 2 pdr. By the time the A15 is in the field, some of the German tanks are impervious to the 2 pdr from the front; you will need to be more circumspect and look for side or rear-aspect shots to succeed. Drive it like an armored car. Pay close attention to your situation and don't stand and fight anything. Don't be afraid to stop and look around, as long as you're in cover; the green coloring will hide you from cursory examination.
As with the A13, you need to fear air attack because your top armor can be penetrated by fighter machineguns. If you are immobilized by enemy fire (as long as you're not burning with a big black cloud of smoke), you can still impact the fight. The camouflage paint is again useful in deceiving your opponents.
Control Variations: The driver spawns in with view slit armor in place but can zoom when the view slit is open (numpad . or Del key). The O key opens a bigger view window, which can also be magnified. The gunsight has no range adjustment or gradation available through the gunsight. Only AP ammunition is carried.
